Abstract summary: When LLM weights are open or fine-tuning is available through an API, suppressing hazardous knowledge and tendencies is not enough: removal has to be deep enough that an adversary cannot restore it. Existing unlearning is shallow by this standard: fine-tuning or a handful of in-context examples brings the behaviour back, and it Out of scope: LLM unlearning/security.
title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
